output_envelope.description: Every tool returns an object with at least these keys.

anova_oneway.description: One-way ANOVA across ≥2 groups → `{f_statistic, df_between, df_within, p_value}`.

bayes_theorem.description: Posterior P(H|E) from prior P(H), likelihood P(E|H), false-alarm P(E|¬H) → `{posterior, evidence}`.

bell_number.description: The n-th Bell number Bₙ — partitions of an n-element set. E.g. B₅ = 52.

cache_stats.description: Deterministic-memoization cache statistics: hits, misses, hit-rate, size (K1 observability).

catalan_number.description: The n-th Catalan number Cₙ. E.g. C₅ = 42 (balanced parentheses, binary trees, …).

characteristic_polynomial.description: Characteristic polynomial det(A − λI) of a square matrix. E.g. diag(2,3) → `lambda**2 - 5*lambda + 6`.

check_arrays.description: Reason about ARRAYS with `select(a, i)` / `store(a, i, v)` (McCarthy axioms).

check_bitvector.description: Reason over fixed-width BIT-VECTORS (bit tricks, masks, overflow).

check_certificate.description: Verifies a result INDEPENDENTLY of the engine that PRODUCED it (Z3/SymPy), using stdlib only.

check_modal.description: Is a propositional MODAL formula valid in a normal system (K/T/D/B/S4/S5)?

check_strings.description: Reason about STRINGS/sequences (concat, length, contains, prefix/suffix).

check_uninterpreted.description: Reason with EQUALITY + UNINTERPRETED functions/predicates (EUF, congruence).

check_unsat_proof.description: Independently verify a DRUP UNSAT `proof` for a CNF (bring your own proof from any solver).

chi_square_test.description: χ² goodness-of-fit test → `{chi_square, df, p_value}`. E.g. [10,20,30,40] vs uniform → p≈0.0002.

chinese_remainder.description: Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT): x ≡ residues[i] (mod moduli[i]). If incompatible, an honest error.

cholesky_decomposition.description: Cholesky A = L·Lᵀ (L lower-triangular) → `{L}`. Needs symmetric positive-definite (else error).

classify.description: Classify a formula: tautology / contradiction / contingent.

classify_ode.description: Classifies an ODE — the applicable SymPy solution methods (e.g. `separable`, `1st_linear`).

combinations.description: C(n,k) — the number of unordered selections of `k` from `n` objects (binomial coefficient).

complex_parts.description: Splits a complex expression into real and imaginary parts → `{real, imag}`.

condition_number.description: 2-norm condition number κ(A) = σ_max/σ_min. Large κ ⟹ ill-conditioned; `null` if singular.

confidence_interval.description: t-based confidence interval for the mean → `{mean, lower, upper, margin, confidence}`.

connected_components.description: Connected components → `{count, is_connected, components}`. `nodes` adds isolated vertices.

consistency.description: Can these statements ALL be true at once? (consistency / satisfiability)

continued_fraction.description: Continued-fraction terms of the rational numerator/denominator. E.g. 415/93 → `[4,2,6,7]`.

continued_fraction_sqrt.description: Periodic continued fraction of √n → `{a0, period}`. E.g. √23 → `{a0:4, period:[1,3,1,8]}`.

contour_integral.description: ∮_C f dz by the RESIDUE THEOREM = 2πi·Σ Res(f, pole) over the ENCLOSED `poles` you supply.

correlation.description: Pearson correlation ρ ∈ [−1, 1]. Exact; undefined (error) if a variable has zero variance.

covariance.description: Covariance Cov(X,Y) of two equal-length datasets (population; `sample` divides by n−1). Exact.

critical_points.description: Unconstrained critical points (∇f = 0), each classified via the Hessian.

cross_check.description: Verifies the `left = right` claim INDEPENDENTLY with Z3 AND SymPy; seeks consensus.

cross_check_numeric.description: SYMBOLIC↔NUMERIC cross-validation of f(point): evaluate two independent ways and confirm agreement.

curl.description: ∇×F — curl of a 3-D vector field. Requires exactly 3 components and 3 variables (e.g. x,y,z).

definite_integral.description: Definite integral ∫ₐᵇ f dx. Bounds may be infinite ("oo"/"-oo").

derangements.description: Derangement count !n (permutations with no fixed point; inclusion-exclusion). E.g. !4 = 9.

determinant.description: Determinant of a square matrix. Cells may be numeric or symbolic.

differentiate.description: Takes the order-th derivative of the expression with respect to `symbol`.

directional_derivative.description: Dᵤf — directional derivative ∇f·û along the NORMALIZED `direction` (same length as variables).

distribution.description: E[X]/Var/std (symbolic/exact) properties of a named distribution.

divergence.description: ∇·F — divergence of a vector field: Σ ∂Fᵢ/∂xᵢ (field and variables must match in length).

eigenvalues.description: Eigenvalues of a square matrix + algebraic multiplicity.

eigenvectors.description: Eigenvalue + algebraic multiplicity + eigenvector(s). Sorted by eigenvalue (determinism).

eliminate_quantifiers.description: QUANTIFIER ELIMINATION: turn a quantified linear-arithmetic formula into an equivalent quantifier-free one.

engine_metrics.description: Structured engine metrics (K3 observability): call counts, status distribution, per-tool latency.

entail_batch.description: Check MANY conclusions against SHARED premises via INCREMENTAL solving (Z3 push/pop) (K1).

entailment.description: Do the premises LOGICALLY entail the conclusion? (premises ⊨ conclusion)

enumerate_models.description: Enumerates the DISTINCT models satisfying the statements (at most `limit`).

equivalent.description: Are two expressions logically EQUIVALENT? (same truth value under every assignment)

euler_totient.description: Euler's totient φ(n) — the count of 1..n coprime to n. E.g. φ(12) = 4.

evaluate_precision.description: Evaluates a CONSTANT expression to `digits` significant figures (arbitrary precision). E.g. `pi`.

factorial.description: n! — the product of the first `n` positive integers (0! = 1).

find_real_solution.description: Finds a point in the REALS satisfying a set of nonlinear constraints.

find_root_bisection.description: Bisection for a root in [a, b]. Requires a SIGN CHANGE f(a)·f(b) < 0 (else honest error).

find_root_newton.description: Newton's method for a root from `x0` → `{root, iterations, residual, converged}`.

find_root_secant.description: Secant method for a root from two starting points (no derivative needed).

fourier_transform.description: Fourier transform (SymPy convention ∫ f(x)·e^(−2πi·k·x) dx). e.g. `exp(-x**2)` → `sqrt(pi)*exp(-pi**2*k**2)`.

gcd.description: Greatest common divisor of two integers (GCD).

generated_group.description: Order (+ abelian, degree) of the permutation group generated by `generators` (array form).

generating_function_coefficient.description: Coefficient of `symbol`ⁿ in a generating function's series. E.g. `1/(1-x-x**2)` at 6 → 13 (F₇).

gradient.description: ∇f — partial derivatives of `expression` w.r.t. each variable (list).

gram_schmidt.description: Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization of a list of vectors (orthonormal if `normalize`).

graph_coloring.description: Colors a graph with `colors` colors (neighbors differ). NP-complete graph k-coloring.

group_order.description: Order (+ whether abelian) of a named group: `symmetric`/`alternating`/`cyclic`/`dihedral`.

hamiltonian_path.description: Is there a Hamiltonian path (or `cycle`) visiting every vertex once? (NP-complete)

hessian.description: Hessian matrix — the second partial-derivative matrix of a scalar function (symmetric).

integrate.description: Takes the indefinite integral of the expression w.r.t. `symbol` (+C).

interpolate.description: Lagrange polynomial through `points` ([x,y] list). E.g. (0,1),(1,3),(2,7) → `x**2 + x + 1`.

interpret_natural.description: Turns a natural-language math expression into a FORMAL task (recognize-or-reject).

inverse_laplace_transform.description: Inverse Laplace transform ℒ⁻¹{F(s)}(t). Unilateral → a `Heaviside(t)` factor is expected.

is_isomorphic.description: Are two undirected graphs isomorphic? Backtracking + degree pruning (≤10 nodes) → `{isomorphic, mapping}`.

is_prime.description: Is `n` prime? (deterministic primality test). Returns: `result` = true/false.

jacobian.description: Jacobian matrix — the partial-derivative matrix of a vector-valued function.

joint_marginal.description: Marginal distribution from a joint probability table. `axis`: `row` → P(X), `col` → P(Y).

jordan_form.description: Jordan canonical form A = P·J·P⁻¹ (J block-diagonal) → `{P, J}`.

lagrange_multipliers.description: Equality-constrained optimization via Lagrange multipliers (∇f = Σλᵢ∇gᵢ, gᵢ = 0).

laplace_transform.description: Laplace transform ℒ{f(t)}(s) = ∫₀^∞ f(t)·e^(−st) dt. e.g. `t` → `s**(-2)`, `sin(t)` → `1/(s**2+1)`.

laplacian.description: ∇²f — Laplacian of a scalar field: Σ ∂²f/∂xᵢ². (0 ⟺ harmonic.)

latin_square.description: Complete an n×n Latin square (each symbol 1..n once per row and column).

laurent_series.description: Laurent series of `expression` around `point` up to `order` — includes negative powers.

lcm.description: Least common multiple of two integers (LCM).

least_squares.description: Least-squares solution of A·x ≈ b (minimizes ‖A·x − b‖) for overdetermined systems.

limit.description: Limit of the expression as `symbol` → `point`. direction: both | + | - (one-sided).

line_integral.description: ∫_C F·dr — line integral of a vector field along a curve parametrized by `param`.

linear_diophantine.description: Solves the equation `a·x + b·y = c` over INTEGERS (parameter `t_0`).

linear_regression.description: OLS regression y = slope·x + intercept → `{slope, intercept, r, r_squared, p_value}` (slope=0 test).

lu_decomposition.description: LU decomposition: A = P·L·U. Returns: `L`, `U` matrices + `perm` (row swaps).

markov_stationary.description: Stationary distribution π (π·P = π, Σπ = 1) of a row-stochastic transition matrix. Exact.

markov_step.description: Distribution after `steps` steps: initial·Pᵏ. E.g. [1,0] on [[1/2,1/2],[1/4,3/4]], 2 → [3/8,5/8].

matrix_inverse.description: Inverse of a square matrix (A⁻¹). If singular (det=0), an HONEST error.

matrix_multiply.description: Product of two matrices A·B. If inner dimensions (A columns = B rows) mismatch, an honest error.

matrix_rank.description: Rank of a matrix (number of linearly independent rows/columns). Need not be square.

matrix_solve.description: Solves the linear system `A x = b` in matrix form.

max_flow.description: Maximum flow source→sink (Edmonds-Karp). Directed `[u,v,capacity]`. Equals the min-cut capacity.

max_satisfy.description: Satisfy the mandatory (`hard`) constraints and AS MANY (weighted) `soft` constraints as possible (MaxSAT).

maximum_matching.description: Maximum bipartite matching (Kuhn). `left` = the left-partition nodes → `{size, matching}`.

mean.description: Arithmetic mean of a list of numbers (exact/rational).

median.description: Median. With an even number of observations, the mean of the middle two.

minimum_spanning_tree.description: Minimum spanning tree/forest (Kruskal). Edges `[u,v,weight]` → `{edges, total_weight, spans_all}`.

mobius.description: Möbius μ(n): 0 if a squared prime divides n, else (−1)^(#distinct primes). E.g. μ(30) = −1.

model.description: Returns a CONCRETE example (variable assignment) satisfying the statements.

modular_inverse.description: Multiplicative inverse of `a` modulo `m`. If none (gcd(a,m)≠1), an honest error.

n_queens.description: Place `n` non-attacking queens on an n×n board (N-queens, SAT reduction).

necklace_count.description: Distinct necklaces of `n` beads in `colors` colors under rotation (Burnside/Pólya). n=4,c=2 → 6.

nullspace.description: A basis of the null space (kernel). Empty list = only zero (trivial).

numerical_eigenvalues.description: Numerical eigenvalues of a square matrix (mpmath). Complex ones reported as `a ± b*I`.

numerical_integrate.description: Numerical integral over [lower, upper] via composite `simpson` or `trapezoid`. E.g. x² on [0,3] → 9.

optimize.description: Find the solution that satisfies the constraints and maximizes/minimizes (`sense`) the numeric `objective`.

partition_count.description: p(n) — the number of ways to write `n` as a sum of positive integers.

pell_solution.description: Fundamental solution of the Pell equation x² − n·y² = 1 → `{x, y}`. E.g. n=13 → `{x:649, y:180}`.

permutation_compose.description: Composes permutations (array form) left-to-right; returns the result array + its order.

permutation_order.description: Order of a permutation given in ARRAY form (0-indexed images). E.g. `[1,2,0]` → 3.

permutation_parity.description: Parity of a permutation (array form): `even` or `odd`. E.g. `[1,0,2]` (a transposition) → odd.

permutations.description: P(n,k) — the number of ordered selections of `k` from `n` objects (0 if k>n).

pigeonhole.description: Proves that `n+1` pigeons cannot fit into `n` holes (the pigeonhole principle).

primitive_root.description: Smallest primitive root mod `n` (generator of the units), or `null` when none exists (honest).

prove.description: If the premises entail the conclusion, shows WHY — minimal core + step-by-step derivation.

prove_by_induction.description: Prove `∀ {var} ≥ {start}. {claim}` by MATHEMATICAL INDUCTION (Z3 can't do this natively).

prove_inequality.description: Does the `goal` inequality hold for ALL real values (under the assumptions)?

prove_nonnegative.description: Does `expression ≥ 0` hold for every real value (under the assumptions)?

prove_unsat.description: Decide a CNF and, when UNSAT, return an INDEPENDENTLY-VERIFIED DRUP certificate (J2).

pseudoinverse.description: Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverse A⁺ (works for non-square / singular A).

pythagorean_coloring.description: Tries to 2-color {1..n} with no monochromatic Pythagorean triple.

qr_decomposition.description: QR decomposition A = Q·R (Q orthonormal columns, R upper-triangular) → `{Q, R}`.

quadratic_residue.description: Is `a` a quadratic residue mod `n`? → `{is_residue, jacobi_symbol}` (Legendre when n is prime).

ramsey_coloring.description: 2-color the edges of K_n avoiding a red K_s and a blue K_t (Ramsey reduction).

residue.description: Residue Res(f, z₀) of `expression` at the pole `point` (may be complex, e.g. `I`).

resource_limits.description: The engine's ACTIVE resource fences (K3): statement/expression/depth caps, default timeout &

rref.description: Reduced row echelon form (RREF) + pivot column indices.

runge_kutta.description: RK4 solver for the IVP y' = f(x, y), y(x0)=y0, up to x_end → `{x_end, y_end, trajectory}`.

schur_number.description: Tries to partition {1..n} into `colors` sum-free colors (the core of the Schur number S(colors)).

series.description: Taylor/series expansion of the expression around `symbol`=`point` to order `order`.

shortest_path.description: Shortest path source→target. Edges `[u,v]` or `[u,v,weight]` (set `weighted`). Dijkstra/BFS.

singular_values.description: Singular values σᵢ of a matrix (largest first). E.g. `[[4,0],[3,-5]]` → `[2*sqrt(10), sqrt(10)]`.

solve.description: Solves an equation for a variable (e.g. 'x**2 == 4', symbol='x').

solve_cnf.description: Solve a CNF at SCALE with a high-performance CDCL backend (CaDiCaL via python-sat) (J3).

solve_ode.description: Solves an ordinary differential equation (ODE). Derivative: `y'`, `y''` (prime).

solve_ode_ivp.description: Solves an ODE with initial/boundary conditions (IVP or BVP).

solve_ode_system.description: Solves a SYSTEM of ODEs for `functions` of one variable. Primes: `f'`, `g''`.

solve_pde.description: Solves a first-order linear PDE (SymPy `pdsolve`). Partials via `D(u, x)`, `D(u, y)`.

solve_recurrence.description: Solves a linear recurrence relation to CLOSED FORM.

solve_system.description: Solves a SYSTEM of equations for multiple variables.

standard_deviation.description: Standard deviation = √variance (the sample option is the same as variance).

stirling_number.description: Stirling number of the `first` (cycles) or `second` (blocks) kind. E.g. S(5,2) 2nd = 15.

subset_sum.description: Does a subset of `numbers` sum to `target`? (NP-complete subset-sum).

sudoku_solve.description: Solve a 9×9 Sudoku (`givens` is a 9×9 grid, 0 = blank).

summation.description: Summation Σ — sum of `expression` for `index`=lower..upper (may be closed form).

t_test.description: Student's t-test. One-sample vs `mu` if `sample2` is None, else two-sample (Welch).

tsp_decision.description: Decision TSP: is there a tour visiting every city once with total length ≤ `budget`?

van_der_waerden.description: Tries to `colors`-color {1..n} with no monochromatic k-term arithmetic progression.

verify_derivation.description: Audits a multi-step derivation by REPLAYING each transition's cited operation.

verify_equality.description: Are two expressions EQUIVALENT? (independently checks an AI's "= equals this" claim.)

verify_integral.description: Is `∫ expression d{symbol}` really `claimed`? (a +C constant difference is tolerated.)

verify_matrix_identity.description: Are two matrices (including symbolic cells) EQUAL? Dimension/first differing cell is reported.

verify_numeric.description: Verifies a CLAIMED numerical value against the exact high-precision value → `{match, exact_value, absolute_error}`.

verify_series.description: Is the order-`order` Taylor expansion of `expression` around `{symbol}={point}` really `claimed`?

verify_solution.description: Are the `claimed` values solutions of `equation`, and are they COMPLETE? (an AI's solution claim.)

verify_steps.description: In a chain of expressions, is each step EQUIVALENT to the previous — finds the first bad transition.

z_test.description: One-sample z-test with KNOWN population σ → `{z_statistic, p_value}` (two-tailed).

z_transform.description: Unilateral Z-transform Z{x[n]}(z) = Σ_{n≥0} x[n]·z^(−n) — closed form + ROC.
